# FermionicML notebook release -- MODERN environment (floor pins).
#
# CAVEATS -- read before choosing this over requirements-pinned.txt:
#   * Checkpoint restore + CPU-f64 forward verification are VERIFIED on
#     this stack (validated on python 3.13 / jax 0.10.2 / flax 0.12.8 /
#     numpy 2.3.5 / scipy 1.16.3).
#   * The pmap-based TRAINING cells self-gate on modern stacks (they check
#     the runtime and skip/downshift rather than train differently);
#     full-scale retraining is supported ONLY on the pinned stack of
#     requirements-pinned.txt.
#   * Retrained numbers are never byte-compared across stacks anyway --
#     equivalence is at the forward-pass/score level (RETRAIN.md).

# Floor: Python >= 3.12 (pip cannot pin the interpreter from a
# requirements file -- create the env at py>=3.12 yourself).
